answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to a rotating on-call roster for real incidents: every agent must answer unpredictable pages within minutes and resolve the issue live, with response times recorded in a crystal-clear public log timed by a quartz clock. One operator cannot staff two pages at once, so each extra fake identity needs another human on call around the clock plus a standby bond paid in outside money that doubles for each further identity on the same funding trail. A missed page burns the bond.
